text: Light as a breath. Fletchers and saddlers use them.
name: Gale Feather

text: A flight feather that crackles when you bend it.
name: Stormquill

text: Only the great flyers grow these. It never lies still.
name: Tempest Plume

text: Salty, slick and harder than it looks.
name: Brine Scale

text: Grown in the dark under a sea creature's tongue.
name: Deep Pearl

text: It beats like the surf. Some say it remembers the sea.
name: Tidal Heart

text: A chip of a stone creature's hide.
name: Gritstone

text: Still warm. Smiths quench blades in its heat.
name: Basalt Core

text: A glowing core from the deep fire of a stone giant.
name: Magma Heart

text: Living bark that keeps growing a few days after.
name: Thornbark

text: Plant it and a tree shoots up overnight. Do not plant it.
name: Wildbloom Seed

text: The oldest wood of a forest beast, dense as iron.
name: Heartwood Knot

text: Tough hide from a land creature. Saddlers want it.
name: Rough Hide

text: Supple and strong: the hide of a rarer creature.
name: Fine Hide

text: Long, sharp and a little bit scary to carry.
name: Beast Fang

text: A scale shed in the fight. It turns a blade.
name: Dragon Scale

text: Hollow and light, harder than steel. From the great dragons.
name: Wyrm Bone

text: What is left in the air after a legend falls. It hums.
name: Primal Essence

text: Resets a sky of skills (Inner Sky). Falls from legends, rarely.
name: Starstuff

text: Black iron from Thrallbinder gear. The smiths of every town want it.
name: Thrall Iron

text: A broken shard of a binding rune. It still glows green.
name: Rune Fragment

text: A whole binding crystal. Runed weapons are forged around one.
name: Thrall Crystal

text: The badge of a Thrallbinder. Traders pay well to see one burn.
name: Binder's Sigil

text: The mask of a Thrallbinder lieutenant. The bounty board pays for these.
name: Lieutenant's Mask

text: The heart stone of a Titan. Only a few riders have held one.
name: Titan Heart

text: Rivets, buckles and bent plate from gear taken apart. The smith upgrades gear with it.
name: Forge Scrap

text: Ground from the runes of good gear. The smith needs it for high upgrades and rerolls.
name: Rune Dust

text: Steel with a fallen star in it. Only the last upgrades (+9 and +10) need it.
name: Starsteel Ingot

text: A piece of the old makers' work. Nobody knows what it did.
name: Valdren Relic

text: Black wood and a knot of runes, taken from a Binder in Whisperpine. It hums the same note as the anchors did. Grimma would give a lot to take it apart.
name: Binder's Staff

text: Sea grey and warm, with Halcyon's blue markings on the shell. He kept it warm through all of it. It sleeps in Edda's hatchery now.
name: Halcyon's Egg

text: Red and gold, Ironvein colours. Sable threw it at you after the midnight race and did not look back to see if you caught it.
name: Sable's Race Ribbon

text: A hooded lantern from Sable. Its light finds the Shade Scouts in the dark from further away than any torch.
name: Shade Lantern

text: A grey scale from beside Wren's sleeping dragon. At night it glows faintly. Green.
name: Ashwing Scale

text: Nix owes the bearer one favor. Valid never.
name: Nix's IOU

text: Grey wool, smelling of incense, stolen off a drying line in the Low Docks of Aurelith. In it, nobody in the city looks at you twice.
name: Pilgrim's Veil

text: A brass plate from the archive of the Rune Forge. Seed 4471. Struck: one ashwing, knight-bonded, inner wall. Result: turned on its riders. Not returned. Fifteen marks along the edge.
name: Seed Plate 4471

text: The gold tip of Lancemaster Corvid's lance, snapped off over the Strait of Lanterns. The first thing he ever lost.
name: Corvid's Lance Tip

text: A conch from the Coral Terraces. Blow it and four notes come out, in the order the tide remembers. The Tidemother lets you near.
name: Song Shell

text: A grey pearl from the bottom of the Churn's eye, still turning slowly in your palm. Saddlers want it for a Stormrider saddle.
name: Maelstrom Pearl

text: A merfolk guard's round shield in pearl and sea-green, given by Captain Nerea. Everyone in the Dome knows what it means.
name: Dome Defender Shield

text: Knight Registers, volume nine. Ashveil, grey ashwing, eyes pale. Bonded to Capt. Ysolde Vane. Recorded dead, Ashfall Isle, fifteen years past.
name: Ledger Page

text: Found by the flint on Castaway Shore. Pale gold, a rune where a king's head should be, and minted this year. Nobody beyond the wall should be minting anything.
name: Valdren Coin

text: Brass, dented, the Ironvein crest worn almost smooth. Sable handed it over without a word. That is the strangest part.
name: Sable's Spyglass

text: Iron spikes for your boots, taken off a Shade Scout on the Bone Stair. The wind has a harder time with you now.
name: Bone Stair Spikes

text: A scale Thunderwing shook loose when the thrall burned out. It still crackles. Stormforged smiths would trade a forge for it.
name: Thunderwing's Static Scale

text: A chest of storm-glass, left on the stair after Thunderwing flew free. Everyone who fought got one.
name: Warden's Blessing

text: A merfolk storm chart from the Storm Archives, in tide-script. Four spirals round the ring of islands. One of them is dark.
name: Warden Chart

text: Speaker Thalassa's seal in blue wax on a shell disc. The serpent ferries carry whoever shows it, free.
name: Accord Seal

text: A braid of white Kelpie mane, tied to a saddle ring. Old Pell says it makes the sea like you a little more.
name: Kelpie Hair Charm

text: A splinter of the Crown Spire, struck three times in one night. It still crackles. Saddlers want it for the Stormrider saddle.
name: Stormglass Shard

text: A cape of storm grey feathers the Storm Roc shed on the Drift Rocks. It smells of rain and ozone.
name: Roc Feather Mantle

text: A chip of green glass from a Valdren statue's face. Hold it up and hidden things nearby seem to flinch.
name: Watcher's Eye

text: Shed in the warm mud of the wallow. Long as your forearm and still sharp. A saddler would know what to do with it.
name: Twinfang Fang

text: A curl of shell from Thunderwing's nest. It still makes your fingers tingle.
name: Static Eggshell

text: Gloves faced with scales the second Warden shed in her sleep. They crackle when the weather turns.
name: Thunderwing Scale Gauntlets

text: The Tidemother's binding pattern on a chained rune stone. Under it, older and fainter, a pattern with five throats.
name: Thrall Key

text: Stormforged. Shed by the first Warden the morning it was free. It hums like the wall.
name: Hydra Scale

text: A chest of storm-blue shells and old coins the Hydra brought up from the deep for every rider who fought for it.
name: Warden's Blessing

text: A Dragon Knight lance, snapped in two. Worn into the grip: E.S. to Y.V. Hold on tighter.
name: Edda's Old Lance

text: The rune from Ashveil's saddle, split down the middle. Under it, cut deeper and older, another one.
name: Cracked Saddle Rune

text: Black iron, plain, cold. The Captain dropped it on Burnt Ridge. It belongs on a wall at your ranch, facing the storm.
name: Vane's Mask

text: Eaten at the start of your next tame: its target zone is 15 percent wider.
name: Taming Treat

text: Some creatures only come close for bait. Used when you start to tame one.
name: Deepwater Bait

text: Drink it from your bag (B): 35 percent of your health back.
name: Healing Draught

text: Drink it from your bag (B): 70 percent of your health back.
name: Greater Draught

text: Your mount hits 2 percent harder. You made it yourself with Brann: crooked on the left, but it holds.
name: Stitched Saddle

text: Your mount hits 3 percent harder: a good seat is half the fight.
name: Rider's Saddle

text: Your mount hits 6 percent harder. Stitched with the Guild's mark.
name: Guild Saddle

text: Your mount hits 10 percent harder. Saltreach steel and wyrm bone.
name: Dragoon Saddle

text: Forged by a smith from Thrall Iron. Hits 8 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Tempered Saber

text: Thrall steel around a binding crystal. Taken from Thrallbinder camps. Hits 16 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Runed Saber

text: Carried by the Thrallbinder lieutenants. Hits 25 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Stormforged Saber

text: Grown from a Titan's bones. Only the Titans give these. Hits 35 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Titanbound Saber

text: Forged by a smith from Thrall Iron. Hits 8 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Tempered Longbow

text: Thrall steel around a binding crystal. Taken from Thrallbinder camps. Hits 16 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Runed Longbow

text: Carried by the Thrallbinder lieutenants. Hits 25 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Stormforged Longbow

text: Grown from a Titan's bones. Only the Titans give these. Hits 35 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Titanbound Longbow

text: Forged by a smith from Thrall Iron. Hits 8 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Tempered Bondstaff

text: Thrall steel around a binding crystal. Taken from Thrallbinder camps. Hits 16 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Runed Bondstaff

text: Carried by the Thrallbinder lieutenants. Hits 25 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Stormforged Bondstaff

text: Grown from a Titan's bones. Only the Titans give these. Hits 35 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Titanbound Bondstaff

text: Forged by a smith from Thrall Iron. Hits 8 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Tempered Emberlock

text: Thrall steel around a binding crystal. Taken from Thrallbinder camps. Hits 16 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Runed Emberlock

text: Carried by the Thrallbinder lieutenants. Hits 25 percent harder than a plain one.
name: Stormforged Emberlock
